resolution.note: replay.sh retries API/auth/overload errors like usage limits; runs.ts never grades them

title: D23 replay never grades a session that ended on an API or auth error
body:
Why: dev-k4 (.krn/runs/d23-comparison/v2/dev-k4) graded 560 and 621 WRONG although both sessions ended 'Failed to authenticate. API Error: 403' with subtype success; evals/d23/replay.sh only detects usage-limit text, so infra failures count as K losses.
Outcome: replay.sh and runs.ts classify API/auth/overload errors like usage limits: the run is retried and never graded.
Proof: unit test over captured claude.json results (403 auth, 529 overload, usage limit, a normal answer quoting 'API Error'); dev-k4 regrade drops 560 and 621.
Scope: evals/d23/, test/evals/.
